module TopModule(input clk, input reset, input x, output reg z);
  reg [2:0] y, ny;
  always @(*) begin
    case (y[2:0])
      3'b000: begin ny=3'b000; z=1'b0; end
      3'b001: begin ny=(x) ? 3'b001 : 3'b000; z=1'b0; end
      3'b010: begin ny=(x) ? 3'b001 : 3'b000; z=1'b0; end
      3'b011: begin ny=(x) ? 3'b010 : 3'b001; z=1'b1; end
      3'b100: begin ny=(x) ? 3'b100 : 3'b011; z=1'b1; end
      default: begin ny=3'b000; z=1'b0; end
    endcase
  end
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) y <= 3'b000;
    else y <= ny;
  end
endmodule

module TopModule(input  clk, input reset, input x, output reg z);

module TopModule(input clk, input reset, input x, output reg z);
  reg [2:0] y, y_next;
  always @(*) begin
    case (y)
      3'b001: begin y_next = x ? 3'b001 : 3'b000; z = 1'b0; end
      3'b010: begin y_next = x ? 3'b001 : 3'b010; z = 1'b0; end
      3'b011: begin y_next = x ? 3'b010 : 3'b001; z = 1'b1; end
      3'b100: begin y_next = x ? 3'b100 : 3'b001; z = 1'b0; end
      default: begin y_next = 3'b000; z = 1'b0; end
    endcase
  end
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) y <= 3'b000;
    else y <= y_next;
  end
endmodule
